people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Hanun
people.line: An Ammonite king who mistreated David's envoys.

translations.web: After this, the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: Some time later, the king of the Ammonites died and was succeeded by his son Hanun.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.
